doc: Task 11c: an allow-list entry pinned by a tag, not a digest, is not run (refused before podman is asked).

args: set -e; podman pull -q docker.io/library/busybox:1.36 >/dev/null; d=$(podman image inspect --format '{{.Digest}}' docker.io/library/busybox:1.36); mkdir -p $ROOT/work;  printf '(drgnx-settings :version 1 (drgnx-agents-container-images (("busybox" . "docker.io/library/busybox:1.36"))) )\n' "$d" > $CONFIG/settings.el; chmod 600 $CONFIG/settings.el
